citation.title: Fast topology optimization of phononic crystal-based metastructures for vibration isolation by deep learning
citation.authors: Chen-Xu Liu, Gui-Lan Yu, Zhanli Liu
citation.version_coded: version-of-record abstract only; full text inaccessible

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The deep learning optimization method attains results similar to or better than a genetic algorithm while using 0.01% of its runtime.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Abstract reports DLBO time as 0.01% of GA time; 1 / 0.0001 = 10,000-fold GA-time-to-DLBO-time ratio.
claim.alternatives: Abstract also says the vibration-isolation performance of a subway-oriented design is verified by a 3D finite element model.

baseline.classical_time: not stated; DLBO is reported to use 0.01% of GA time (abstract)
baseline.quality_metric: Similarity or improvement of results relative to GA; vibration isolation verified using 3D finite element model (abstract)
baseline.quality_gap: Similar or better results than GA; magnitude not stated in accessible abstract

notes: Publisher abstract states datasets and code are shared and reports 0.01% of GA runtime. Wiley full-text and PDF routes returned access errors; no access restriction was bypassed. Abstract source: https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/mice.13100.
